lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of vertically aligned columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible across the mid-lateral flank. Each column contains between 4 and 6 distinct local maxima, spaced at relatively regular intervals along the longitudinal axis posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable, intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient where the superior surface reflects high-intensity ambient light and the inferior surface is in shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing (posterior) edge of the pectoral fin displays non-linear, irregular margins and notches, suggesting historical tissue loss or abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are positioned in the ventral space, one directly below the pectoral fin and another further posterior.
